Kapil sells a mobile to Sachin at a gain of 15% and Sachin again sells it to Rohit at a
profit of 12%. If Rohit pays Rs.322, what is the cost price of the mobile for Kapil?

2. Rs.450
3. Rs.250
4. Rs.325
